sources.description: Provenance labels for reported oncology facts and file metadata. Selected prepared source reports are linked; original records and private crosswalks remain private.

sample_links.description: Specimen-level links between clinical and molecular records; exact assay aliquot/block linkage remains separately qualified.

samples.description: Specimen-level map. Unknown values remain null or explicitly unresolved; public IDs are distinct from laboratory identifiers.

assays.description: Assay descriptions with explicit genome build, source uncertainty and raw-versus-derived status.

findings.description: Selected report-derived molecular facts; prior extractions are labelled and not represented as fresh clinical validation.

variants.description: Thirty research-audit loci; mixed genome builds are explicit. These are not a newly validated somatic catalogue.

target_read_evidence.description: Independent selected-locus review of native Tempus alignments/calls and Invoke report snapshots. Counts retain their original units and assay-specific limitations; they are not a clinical validation.

vaccine_evidence.description: Selected unresolved design questions and sequence evidence. Sequences are research observations, not clinical or manufacturing instructions.

raw_file_inventory.description: Inventory of original listed and requested assay files. Released derivatives have explicit links, sizes and hashes; source logical sizes remain distinct. A source archive can produce multiple public objects.

processed_release_catalog.description: Prepared vendor variant calls, RNA fusion candidate calls and expression summaries included in this release; not raw sequencing reads. Source originals remain unchanged.

raw_release_catalog.description: Verified public FASTQ reads, alignment derivatives and regenerated indexes. File sizes and checksums identify the actual downloadable objects; originals remain preserved privately.

limitations: Selected prepared laboratory, clinical and research reports are available under Reports; scientific interpretations retain their provider attribution.
Independent selected-locus counts are research observations, not freshly validated clinical results.
Samples, aliases, reference builds and count units must remain linked; unknown does not mean negative.
Current-node molecular/pathology results and several original sequencing inputs remain missing or pending.

raw_files.release_count_basis: with_public_derivative counts inventoried source entries linked to one or more prepared public sequence/call/expression files; release catalogue counts actual download objects.

processed_files.note: Prepared vendor calls, RNA fusion candidates and expression derivatives retain their own file IDs, sizes and hashes. Selected alignment derivatives are separately listed in raw_release_catalog.
